chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from al-Ala' ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about a man who missed one cycle (rak'ah) with the Imam from the prayer during the days of al-Tashreeq. He said: He completes his prayer, then he says Takbeer.
And I asked him about the Takbeer after each prayer, so he said: As many as you wish, for it is not a fixed number, meaning regarding the speech.

key_terms.أَيَّامَ التَّشْرِيقِ: The days of al-Tashreeq (11th, 12th, and 13th of Dhu al-Hijjah)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for completing missed prayers during the days of al-Tashreeq?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the procedure for a latecomer joining the congregational prayer during the Days of Tashreeq, emphasizing that the missed rak'ah is completed individually before joining the post-prayer Takbeer. The Imam’s response that the number of Takbeers is 'as much as you wish' highlights the Shia view of flexibility (tawassu') in the verbal remembrance, distinguishing it from fixed ritual units. This reflects the broader scholarly understanding that the Takbeer of Tashreeq is a recommended act of gratitude rather than a strictly quantified pillar of prayer.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Al A’ala Bin Razeyn, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from one of the two (5<sup>th</sup> or 6<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I asked himasws about a man who misses one Cycle with the Prayer-leader from the Salaat on the days of Al-Tashreek (11th, 12th & 13th Zilhajj). Heasws said: ‘Heasws said: ‘He should complete his Salaat, then he should exclaim Takbeer’.

And I asked himasws about the exclamation of the Takbeer after each Salaat. So heasws said: ‘As many as you so desire to. There is nothing (specifically) Prescribed’ – meaning regarding the speaking’.
en.sarwar: 5. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan ibn Yahya from al-‘Ala’ ibn Razin from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following: “I once asked one of the two Imam, (abu Ja’far or abu ‘Abd Allah), ‘Alayhim al-Salam,
about a man who misses one Rak’at Salat (prayer) with the Imam of Salat (prayer) in the days of Tashriq. He (the Imam) said, ’He completes his Salat (prayer) and then says Takhir.’

I then asked about Takhir after every Salat (prayer). He (the Imam) said, ‘As many times as you like. There is not anything definite in speaking of Allah.’” NOTE: Fatwa best explains Hadith 4-5 of this Chapter
